detailed_description: Compound Interest Calculator shows how your investments grow over time with the power of compound interest. Configure initial investment, interest rate, compounding frequency, and regular contributions to see projected growth. Visual charts help you understand the impact of different investment strategies.
usage_steps: Choose the investment period in years
Select compounding frequency (daily, monthly, quarterly, annually)
View final amount, total interest, and growth chart
usage_examples: Understand the impact of compounding frequency
